"'''Snogwash'''" was an expletive used to dismiss a claim deemed to be false. [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Meebur Gascon/Legends|Meebur Gascon]] once used this term while arguing with [[DUM-series pit droid/Legends|DUM-series pit droid]] [[WAC-47/Legends|WAC-47]].
